title: Descend transitions between specified origins of the actual quotients
statement: With X,d,phi,hphi,hcompat,M,V as in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-actual-level-descent], suppose bounded-below etale complexes K_n and specified comparison isomorphisms C_n(K_n) ≅ J_n are given, where J_n are the actual finite-quotient coordinates of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-marked-origin]. Then there exist coefficient-restricted maps dK_n and actual scalar-realization isomorphisms on every U,W,f such that every sourcewise normalization arrow of dK_n is universal and these isomorphisms intertwine dK_n with the strict actual quotient tower through [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-coherence]. This statement does not construct any K_n, cohomological bounds, lisse structure or stalk markings.

proof.text: Conjugate actual quotient maps by the supplied comparison isomorphisms and the exact coefficient-interchange maps. Coefficient restriction preserves bounded-below objects. Full faithfulness of derived comparison on such targets gives the unique preimage dK_n.

The quotient scalar-extension transposes are isomorphisms by derived tensor balancing. Compatibility of phi identifies the coefficient maps. Pull the conjugated square to each etale source through the canonical tensor-pullback mate, using its unit identity. Exact faithful inverse image reflects the invertibility of the transpose, which is the universal structured-arrow condition.

Pull the supplied comparisons to U and W and transport through the scalar slice equivalences. Cancel the associated-module-sheaf/restriction comparison and use the strict quotient representative counit. This gives actual. The scalar compositor induces identity on underlying abelian sheaves, and the lifted-square identity gives precisely the stated actual_normalized equation.

theorem finitePerfectAdic_descend_coordinate_transitions
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))))))
    (hKplus : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus (K n))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))) V.left)
        |>.mapDerivedCategory).obj (K n) ≅ finitePerfectAdicQuotientCoordinates X d φ M V n) :
    ∃ dK : ∀ n : ℕ, K (n + 1) ⟶
        (normalizationRestrict V.left.smallEtaleTopology
          (RingHom.ulift (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1)))).obj (K n),
    ∃ actual : ∀ (U : V.left.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt)
        (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) (n : ℕ),
        (finitePerfectAdicScalarRealization X d V U W f n).obj
          ((localProEtaleComparison U.hom (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).obj
            (K n)) ≅
        (finitePerfectAdicRestrictedTower X d W ((completedAdicReduction X d).obj M)).obj
          (op n),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : V.left.Etale), Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal
        (StructuredArrow.mk (etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow V.left
          (RingHom.ulift (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))) (dK n) U)))) ∧
      (∀ (U : V.left.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt)
        (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) (n : ℕ),
        (finitePerfectAdicScalarRealization X d V U W f (n + 1)).map
          (localProEtaleNormalization U.hom
            (RingHom.ulift (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))) (dK n)) ≫
          (finitePerfectAdicScalarCoherence X d V U W f n).hom.app
            ((localProEtaleComparison U.hom (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).obj
              (K n)) ≫
          (actual U W f n).hom =
        (actual U W f (n + 1)).hom ≫
          (finitePerfectAdicRestrictedTower X d W ((completedAdicReduction X d).obj M)).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)
